attr.title: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
attr.desc: Battle your way through a seedy tavern filled with gambling addicted townspeople in this Blackjack Roguelike Adventure. From aces and face cards to tarot cards, business cards and more, create your unique deck to beat the house.
attr.inst: Download the game on Steam and add DnDG_64.pck to the dndg/gamedata/ folder of the port.
